verdict.rationale: Lago's docs explicitly describe an events API for streaming usage (curl POST /api/v1/events) with built-in idempotent deduplication (same event billed once), directly supporting the core ingestion/idempotency ask. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of backdating usage events or explicit high-volume/streaming throughput guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit backdating/timestamp override documentation, high-volume ingestion benchmarks or architecture details.
